svg.title: The Vanilla Shop: Natural Vanilla Tea, 12 bags

g.text: CEYLON BLACK TEA WITH NATURAL VANILLA
One tea bag in hot water
Let it cool, pour over ice
The delicate sweetness of natural vanilla unfolds
through warm, comforting notes and a smooth,
Made with vanilla grown on our own farms.

text.textPath: SAVOR THE CALM · AUTHENTIC CEYLON VANILLA TEA ·
